transcription sites are small and discrete, and that the transcription machinery is organized into a small number of factories, with each factory being capable of supporting a high level of transcriptional activity.

the combination of Br-UTP labeling, cryosectioning, and Br-RNAscope imaging is an efficient way of obtaining accurate counts of nascent transcripts in human cells.

the combination of cryosections and light microscopy can provide a useful compromise between the high resolution of electron microscopy and the ease of light microscopy.
cryosectioning can be an effective approach to improve resolution and to bridge the gap between light and electron microscopy.
